A '''stethoscope''' was a medical tool used to detect a patient's [[Heart/Legends|heartbeat]]. Using a stethoscope on an individual in a [[Hibernation trance/Legends|hibernation trance]] would allow the user to hear a faint and very slow heartbeat.<ref name="RPG" />
